summary: Plan created: 8 phases, ~10.5h, complex. Design decisions resolved explicitly (D1-D7): unconditional check-only backstop in scripts/update-task-status.sh (NOT command-gate-out.sh alone, which is a no-op for the primary meta-task path since skill-implementer flips status inline before gate-out runs); new exit code 6 (0-5 all already allocated -- the research's suggested 5 is superseded, 5 is the missing-shared-library environment error); refusal leaves the task at 'implementing' as a self-resuming ordering constraint mirroring --phase-check=refuse; a missing freshness library degrades to inconclusive pass-through rather than a hard exit, deliberately diverging from the exit-5 precedent because this backstop is unconditional; the backstop performs only the cheap per-extension git-log freshness comparison and never calls deploy-headless.sh OR verify-deploy.sh (enforced by a grep-based contract assertion in the new test suite, not by reviewer memory); baseline-relative verify-deploy.sh --findings set-difference comparison lives exclusively at the two serialized deploy-trigger sites (command-gate-out.sh single-task, commands/implement.md Step 4 multi-task batch), reusing the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint's (a)/(b)/(c) failure contract and exit-2-sentinel folding by reference; skill-orchestrate's Stage MT-3 step 7 predicate is NOT widened (its deployed_critical_paths idempotence store is keyed on critical paths, not extensions -- named as follow-up work with the bounded /orchestrate residual recorded and mitigated by making skill_postflight_update stop silently swallowing the postflight rc, which it does today). file_scope corrected from 4 to 10 entries, written to state.json in Phase 1. The mandatory regeneration-is-manual-only.md carve-out is Phase 7, placed immediately after the existing Automated Exception subsection, in its three-part not-a-side-effect/not-silent/bounded shape, naming both new call sites, stating it is not precedent, and verified by byte-comparing the existing subsection between HEAD and the working tree so a single changed byte fails the phase. Every phase verifies by execution (negative controls, stubbed deploy/verify exit codes, byte-diffs, baseline comparisons) rather than by reading.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase implementation plan (~10.5h) for the postflight deploy gate: shared freshness library, check-only exit-6 backstop in update-task-status.sh, regression suite, two serialized baseline-relative deploy triggers, the mandatory carve-out, and a deploy/self-demonstration phase.
